villagemaster/32092.htm.text: Warehouse Chief Alder: I am Warehouse Chief Alder of the Iron Gate Guild here in Schuttgart. Ah! I cannot abide the chaos I see racing through the world like a forest fire in summer. It's bad enough that the races should war with each other, but each of them is also riven by infighting and discord.…
